files.speech: speech (en), checked on a 2-min sample from 0 s

description: Geometry Nodes editor becomes extremely laggy selecting and dragging nodes in a huge node tree (48,000 nodes, most disconnected).
expected_report: With a node tree exaggerated to 48,000 nodes (only ~1,000 connected to output), selecting or dragging any node takes seconds to respond, even for disconnected nodes. Expected: editor interaction cost should not depend on unconnected nodes; dragging should stay responsive.
difficulty: Dark UI, dense node graph with unreadable labels, the bug is latency between mouse action and response.
